book.title: MUSELU WAPAMA WA YESU woolebiwa ni Luka

content: Yesu Onokohiwa dha Othonga Waaye
Nlabo nimohi mwa mudhidhi, Yesu, asuuzihaga nlogo munyuba ya Mulugu, alaleyaga Muselu Wapama, yahimudheelaga apogo a anamakutha ni anamasuuziha a malamulo, vamohi ni makolo a mutugumano.
Yahimukohaga, wiira: “Onaaddele, odhiilena waani othonga? Wuvahile othonga wula baani?”
Yesu ahaakulaga, wiira: “Miyo teto Ginowukohani yego emohi. Mugaddele:
Amvahile owodha Zhuwawu dha obathiza aali Mulugu, yaali athu?”
Vano aliwa yegi waaddelana mmohi ni mmohiwa, yiiraga “Neera: ‘Mulugu,’ Oliye onowiira: ‘Mwaha mudhe muhumurumeedhege?’
Vano nehi niire: ‘Waali wa athu,’ athu ateene enofiyedha onipa ni mabwe, vowi mmurimani mweewa enolibihedha wi Zhuwawu aali namavuhulela.”
Omamalelowa, yahaakulaga, wiira: “Kannonile.”
Vano, Yesu ahawaakulaga: “Miyo teto kaginowaaddelani ni othonga baani Gineerimina dhego nda.”
Musibe wa Anamalima

Nuwindo, Yesu ahawogelaga athu ale musibe ola: “Mulobwana mmohi ahilima mudda aaye wa mvidera, ahaahiyedha anamalima, oliye ovenya veelaboni vale odhowa elabo emohiwa, ahikala wewule mudhidhi woolapelene.
Ogafiyile mudhidhi wovaha furuta, ahimuruma mwiimeleli aaye wa anamalima ale wi yamvahewo furuta dha mmuddani mule. Mbwenye anamalima ale yahimuddwadhaga, omuweleliha mundduli ahinna yego.
Nuwindo ala ahimuruma mwiimeleli mmohiwa, mbwenye teto ni olena yahimuddwadha, omwiirela dhabure, omuweleliha mundduli ahinna yego.
Nuwindo ahimuruma anethaaruya, teto ni olena yahimporosa, omvokedha okwibi.
“Vano, muliba mudda ole ahiira: ‘Gineere ddi? Gimurume mwaanaga ginamudhivelimi, mwaagahi ola kimuriiha?’
“Anamalima ayo egamoonile, yahaddelanaga mmohi ni mmohiwa. Yiiraga: ‘Ola di namavolowa mba, nimpeni, wi dhoreeladha dhidhe dhikale dheehu.’
Yahimvokedhaga ode, ompa.
“Muliba mudda, onawiirena avi?
Oliye onodha, aatolose anamalima ale, aavahe amoheene muddaya.” Athu egeewile nda, yahiiraga: “Dhi kadhinapadduwa!”
Vano, Yesu ahaasugwaga, wiira: “Yootapulelaya siddi maleba ala eni:

content.text: ndda nihidha osadduwa okala nibwe nohiddeela nyuba?’

content: Olene onatongwele nibwe nddi, onogwaddanyeya; vano ole nnammoreliwa nibwe nddi, onotaateleya.”
Wora emohive elene, anamasuuziha a malamulo, ni apogo a anamakutha yoomusayelaga wi emwihidde, vowi yahiiwaga wi musibe ole, aasibaga aliweene. Mbwenye yowawoovaga athu.
Opeleka Musoko wa Sezari
Vano yoomuhara-hara, yahaaruma athu yanna mukalelo woona ooharihamo, wi yamuwage muwano, emwihidde, yampeleke mu othongi wa kuminadori.
Vano, yahimukohaga, wiira: “Namasuuziha, nihinona wi munowoga, munosuuziha mowogowamwene, kamwinna nsakulo wi ola baani, munosuuziha dila ya Mulugu ni ebaribari.
Dhinorumedheya, naari kadhinarumeedheya wi nipelekege musoko wa Sezari?”
Mbwenye Yesu vonona onaabure weewa, ahawaakulaga:
“Mugoonihe korowa ya gwingwi emohi. Kove elivo sa wani? Ki ndina nilebiwevo tha wani?”
Vano, yahaakulaga: “Ya Sezari.” Yesu ahawiirelaga: “Mumvahege Sezari eli ya Sezari, Mulugu eli ya Mulugu.”
Kayoonile yomwihiddana mmadhuni vameentoni va athu. Vano motikiniheya ni dhowaakula dhaaye, yahimaalaga.
Ebaribari Yovenyihiwa Muukwani
ASaduseyi amohiwa, ayene yaharumeedha wi ohukalawo ovenyihiwa muukwani, yahimwaaddamela Yesu.

Yahimukohaga, wiira: “Namasuuziha, Mozezi ohunilebela nlamulo niiriliye wi akwa ddibila ammohiwa, akala ahitela amwihiya mwihiyana, ahibalana ahima; ddibilaye amutele maamukweleya wi ambalihedhe aana a addibilaye ole.
Vowi yahikalawo addibila atanu ni abiili. Owambeela otela, okwa, ahibalilena ahima.
Anabiili,
anethaaru, emodha-modhave atanu ni abiili ala yahikwa ehimbalihedhe ahima.
Teto omakuthulowa mwihiyana ole okwa.
Mwihiyana ola nlabo novenyihiwa muukwani, onaakale mwadha wani, vowi atanu ni abiili ala yahimutela?”
Yesu ahawaakulaga, wiira: “Athu eli elabo ya vativano enotela, enoteliwa.
Mbwenye ale enakale oofwanelela ofiya elabo enadha eyo, vovenyihiwa muukwani kawuli otela naari oteliwa.
Vowi kinaakwege, enaakale woona angero. Vano enakala ahima a Mulugu, mwaha wovenyihiwa muukwani.
Mozezi ahiwoga wi anookwa enovenyihiwa, vawogiliye thalako ya nikupu nahiddaga munddo, veriliiye wi Nabwiya di, ‘Mulugu a Abarahamu, Mulugu a Ezaaki, Mulugu a Yakobo.
Mulugu kahuwo Mulugu anookwa, di Mulugu athu ookalawo. Vowi wa Oliye ateene ehikanna egumi.”
Vano, amohiwa mwa anamasuuziha a malamulo yahiira: “Namasuuziha, muhaakula pama!”
Egeere ndo, yowoovaga omukoha dhimohidhiwa.
Kirixtu di Nabwiya a Davidi
Vano Yesu ahaakohaga, wiira: “Dhinawogeliwa ddi wi Kirixtu di mwaana a Davidi?
Vowi mwinyeene Davidi ohuwoga mManiivuruni a Masaalimu wiira:
Ki akala Davidi onowiithana ‘Nabwiya.’ Onadha addi okala mwaanaye?”
Athu ateene emvuruwanaga, Yesu ahawaaddelaga anamasuuza aaye:
“Pole-pole ni anamasuuziha a malamulo. Aliwa enodhiveliwa owara dhoowara dhoolapa,
enodhiveliwa vajinjivene olojeliwa mmamisika. Munyuba dha malobelo, enothamagela dhittengu dhowambeela, mburo dhowambeela mmathangani.

Aliwa enowaaka mowaaguva nyuba dha amaamukwele aahiyana, ni wawiiyela dhookalana dheewa mohukalana manyazo, enolobela moolapiha, mowapela malango. Athu ala enodha yoonihiwe goyi yulubale waakwaranya amohi.”
